note: Repository-checkout provider guidance. Active phase manifests and capability registry remain authoritative. This mapping never waives capability invocation, validators, receipts or approvals.

exa_discovery.use: Invoke the repository-configured Exa provider adapter for discovery. If unavailable, follow only the fallback order in the active phase manifest and capability registry.

parallel_verify.use: Invoke the repository-configured independent verification provider. If unavailable, follow only the fallback order in the active phase manifest and capability registry.

firecrawl_extract.use: Invoke the repository-configured Firecrawl adapter only when this conditional capability is active. If unavailable, block as required by the manifest.

vidiq_reference_analysis.use: Invoke the repository-configured vidIQ adapter only when this conditional capability is active. If unavailable, block and request the required provider; do not substitute.

viral_analysis.use: Use the repository-approved viral-analysis guidance only when the capability is active. Treat its output as editorial guidance, never as Zodiac evidence.
